headline: Nevish Line Stirs Anew as Expanse Tilts Colonial
war_summary: Three hours on from our last edition, the map has moved again. The Nevish Line, flag-silent through the morning, has broken out afresh: six flag events in the past two hours, Mistle Shrine and Princefal the busiest points, its casualty ledger still the war's heaviest at better than twenty-six thousand in a day. The Weathered Expanse has tilted Colonial, one Warden post left against five with three in ruin, after forty-five flag events; Crow's Nest and Shattered Advance saw the heaviest traffic there. Linn Mercy keeps up its relentless churn, forty-two events, with Outwich Ranch now jostling Rotdust as the busiest post. Marban Hollow has burst suddenly to life, eleven events inside two hours, all at Checkpoint Bua. Callahans Passage, by contrast, has gone flag-quiet since midmorning, though its guns still claim hundreds of casualties an hour and the sector now stands wholly Warden-held. Mooring County's Wind Hills fight carries on, while Stonecradle remains flag-silent since the previous night. It is day 763; thirty-four victory towns must fall, and no victor is declared.
